lines.t: (Verse 1)
I walked down roads I swore I’d never find,
Carrying echoes of the worst in my mind.
Hands that once reached for heaven’s fire,
Now tremble at the weight of my desire.
All the silver I chased turned to dust in my palm,
The noise of my sin drowning out all calm.
Yet through the distance, soft as a sigh,
I hear Your whisper asking, “Why?”
(Pre-Chorus)
I thought I lost Your love for good,
Torn apart where I had stood.
But mercy waits beyond the gate,
Where I ran from truth, You stayed and prayed.
(Chorus)
YahuShua, still You find me here,
Holding all my guilt and fear.
When I turn away, You draw near,
YahuShua, Your voice is clear.
Even when the night betrays the dawn,
You remind my heart I still belong.
YahuShua, You still find me here.
(Verse 2)
The fire’s gone cold where we used to dine,
My heart feels heavier with passing time.
Could You still call me friend again,
After all the ways I caused this pain?
I hear the wind where Your grace begins,
The sound of love that covers sin.
And somehow, through my quiet tears,
I see Your arms erase my fears.
(Pre-Chorus 2)
I thought I’d closed that sacred door,
But You carved forgiveness into my shore.
My name still echoes in Your song,
I was wrong — but You made me strong.
(Chorus)
YahuShua, still You find me here,
Holding all my guilt and fear.
When I turn away, You draw near,
YahuShua, Your voice is clear.
Even when the night betrays the dawn,
You remind my heart I still belong.
YahuShua, You still find me here.
(Bridge)
You took the blame, You bore my shame,
Crossed the distance, spoke my name.
I was lost, but You saw more,
A broken soul You came here for.
Every scar You turned to grace,
Every tear You did embrace.
The hands that healed the wounded thief,
Were stretched for my belief.
(Final Chorus)
YahuShua, You still find me here,
Even through my hardest year.
When I fall again, You persevere,
YahuShua, You draw me near.
What was sorrow became a song,
What was chained now stands strong.
YahuShua, You still find me here.
(Outro)
The dawn begins, my soul takes flight,
You turned my darkness into light.
YahuShua, forever true,
I was lost — now I’m found in You.
